text: Started a postdoc position at Purdue University.
Successfully defended my Ph.D. Thesis 'Distributionally Robust Nash Equilibrium Seeking With Applications to Task Allocation Among Self-Interested Agents'.
Our paper, 'Behaviorally Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Exploration Using Distributed Task Allocation', has been accepted at Robotics and Automation Letters.
Submitted 'Distributionally Robust Nash Equilibrium Seeking with Partial Observations and Distributed Communication' for peer review.
Presented 'Distributionally Robust Nash Seeking with Partial Observations' at the 46th Southern California Control Workshop, UC Irvive.
Received the Hay Medal (Best Thesis Award) for my MTech (Res) Thesis 'Dynamics of a Stratified Population of Optimum Seeking Agents on a Network'.
Presented 'Control of Discrete-Time LTI Systems Using Stochastic Ensemble Systems' at Siam CT.
Chaired the session 'Agents-Based Systems II' at ACC.
Presented 'Opinion dynamics for utility maximizing agents with heterogeneous resources' at ACC.
